svg.title: The p-value and the effect size answer different questions
svg.desc: Two labelled panels use the same synthetic six-site paired river example at two times. Evidence panel: two-sided p-value 0.0100. Size panel: mean before-minus-after difference 2.833 mg/L, with unadjusted two-sided 95 percent paired-t confidence interval 1.026 to 4.641 mg/L under independent Normal site differences. The river icon is conceptual, not a measured spatial pattern.

g.text: Synthetic concentration at two times · independent Normal differences · assess practical importance
